prior_inspection_disclosure: The18 retained ordinates were already read under v1 before this final model design. v1 x373 had no curve ink. An unexecuted v2 proposal used x371, but independent review correctly noted vertical-grid overlap; v2 is retained and not used. v3 drops that19th point entirely, uses only the original18 supported frozen knots endingx362, and selects no new ordinate. No model has been constructed or executed. No audio has been read.

sources.author: Panasonic
sources.graph: Upper-left DC output voltage VO versus DC input voltage VI

extraction.method: Manual visual centerline ordinates at the original18 supported v1 abscissae, endingx362. The unsupported19th v1 point is excluded with its null/failure preserved, and no new endpoint is introduced. No curve fit, audio fit, knee fitting, smoothing, polynomial or saturation continuation. Actual nominal voltages derive from original raster columns.
extraction.trace_extent_note: Trace visibly ends near VI=4.5 V; do not extend plateau to axis endpoint6 V.

ports.reference: All input/output/supply voltages are absolute volts relative to common VSS=0 V; output is the datasheet graph VO, not a recovered AUX/load-specific pin voltage. No selected pin, tied-output load, current port, target circuit or physical rail assignment is inferred.
ports.condition_policy: Require all explicit finite numeric arguments and exact listed conditions; reject all other conditions. No supply/frequency/temperature scaling or default physical operating levels.

model.nominal: Piecewise-linear interpolation of digitized DC curve, explicit interpolation assumption, no time/clock/sample processor.
model.uncertainty: Graph-reading scenario only, not device spread or confidence interval. Enumerate +/-1 pixel endpoints for each linear axis, map requested VI to each pixel calibration, permit +/-3 pixels horizontal trace reading, and evaluate the nominal piecewise-linear pixel centerline plus/minus3 vertical pixels. All corner evaluations must remain inside measured pixel knot support. Return min/max VO across scenarios.
model.query_domain: Intersection of measured input supports across all horizontal axis/trace reading scenarios. Reject outside it instead of extrapolating. Report separate nominal digitized support and conservative common scenario support.
claims_excluded: Physical PSS780 target bias, voltages or transfer

requirements: Reproduce every stored pixel-to-volt knot with an independent conversion
Nominal exact reproduction of measured knots within the common query domain
Nominal piecewise-linear interpolation checked against independently weighted endpoint interpolation
Scenario bounds contain nominal value and all enumerated scenario corners
Derive common input support from all horizontal scenarios and reject extrapolation
Reject unsupported mode/conditions, missing values, nonnumeric/bool/nonfinite voltage/conditions
Deterministic lookup independent of query order; no mutable signal history
No unsupported AC or physical target claims in public receipt

supersedes.unexecuted_proposal_rejection: x371 may overlap a vertical grid line; use only18 original supported points. This narrows support and does not change an observed ordinate.
